data.name: Farmann
data.gender_notes: Farmann is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German word 'farr', meaning 'man' or 'warrior', and the Old English word 'mann', meaning 'man' or 'human'. The name Farmann can be interpreted as 'steadfast man'. The name Farmann carries the meaning “Steadfast man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Farmann usually hope their child will grow to embody steadfast man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
